fields.climate: hot and dry; arid desert; rainy season varies by region (April to November)
fields.terrain: generally flat, featureless plain; desert dominates the north
fields.hazards: dust storms and periodic persistent droughts
fields.resources: petroleum; small reserves of iron ore, copper, chromium ore, zinc, tungsten, mica, silver, gold; hydropower
fields.farm: sugarcane, sorghum, milk, onions, groundnuts, sesame seeds, goat milk, bananas, mangoes/guavas, millet
fields.exports: crude petroleum, gold, oil seeds, sheep and goats, ground nuts
fields.industries: oil, cotton ginning, textiles, cement, edible oils, sugar, soap distilling, shoes, petroleum refining, pharmaceuticals, armaments, automobile/light truck assembly, milling
fields.languages: Arabic (official), English (official), Nubian, Ta Bedawie, Fur
fields.legal: mixed system of Islamic law and English common law
fields.military: 18-33 years of age for compulsory or voluntary military service for men and women; service obligation 12-24 months
